svg.aria-label: The smoothed octagon K of the library, in circle representation (left): its 8 straight edges (blue) alternate with 8 hyperbolic arcs (orange), inside the octagon O of the edge lines (dashed); the six points s_j* = σ_j(0) lie on the unit circle. The area-preserving map A = diag(0.973, 1.027) takes it to Reinhardt’s smoothed octagon (middle), inside a regular octagon. Right: one corner magnified; σ₀ traces the edge under e₃, the arc under e₁ and the next edge under e₂, and the hyperbola of the arc (dotted) is tangent to both edges
